_comment: GravelHost - Schedule I (Schedule 1) dedicated server. Runs the paid game + MelonLoader + DedicatedServerMod (ifBars, GPL-3.0) headless under Wine. A Steam account that OWNS Schedule I is required for the one-time install only; the running server authenticates anonymously.
name: Schedule I
author: santonu974@gmail.com
description: Schedule I dedicated server via DedicatedServerMod under Wine. Players connect by direct IP:port using the matching client mod. Set S1DS_RUNTIME (mono default, or il2cpp) to match the client build your players use.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# GravelHost Schedule I - fetch and run the versioned installer from the repo.
set -e
curl -fsSL "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/iftekharahmed0427/Docker/main/games/schedule1/install.sh" -o /tmp/s1-install.sh
exec bash /tmp/s1-install.sh

variables.name: Steam Username
variables.description: Steam login of an account that OWNS Schedule I (the shared content account). Used only during install to download the game.

variables.name: Steam Password
variables.description: Password for the content account. Used only during install. For production, set this on the egg and lock user_editable to false.

variables.name: Steam Guard Code
variables.description: Optional. A current Steam Guard code if the account is challenged at install time. Leave blank if the account/host is already trusted.

variables.name: Runtime
variables.description: Game runtime / branch. 'mono' (default, most robust) uses the alternate branch; 'il2cpp' uses the default branch players run and has a slow first boot (one-time Cpp2IL generation). Changing this requires a reinstall.

variables.name: Steam Branch Override
variables.description: Advanced. Force a specific Steam branch. Leave blank to use the correct branch for the selected runtime automatically.

variables.name: Server Name
variables.description: Display name written to server_config.toml on install.

variables.name: Max Players
variables.description: Player cap, kept in sync with server_config.toml on every boot.
